died.name: Robert-François Damiens
died.desc: French domestic servant, attempted assassin of Louis XV
died.last_words: O death, why art thou so long in coming?

died.name: Ralph Abercromby
died.cause: Wounded at the Battle of Alexandria, he asked what had been placed under his head and was told it was "Only a soldier's blanket."
died.last_words: Only a soldier's blanket! Make haste and return it to him at once.

died.name: Virginia Woolf
died.cause: addressing her husband Leonard in her suicide note, drowning herself later that day
died.last_words: I don't think two people could have been happier than we have been.

died.name: Dwight D. Eisenhower
died.last_words: I've always loved my wife, my children, and my grandchildren, and I've always loved my country. I want to go. God, take me.

born.name: Teresa of Ávila
born.desc: Spanish Carmelite nun, mystic and author
born.last_words: Over my spirit flash and float in divine radiancy the bright and glorious visions of the world to which I go.

born.name: Robert Armitage
born.cause: prior to shooting and slightly wounding his wife and then killing himself

born.name: David Ferrie
born.cause: in apparent suicide note (alluding to Galatians 6:7). Ferrie's autopsy concluded that he had died of natural causes
born.last_words: To leave this life, to me, is a sweet prospect. When you read this I will be quite dead and no answer will be possible. All I can say is that I offered you love, and the best I could. All I got in return in the end was a kick in the teeth. Thus I die alone and unloved. As you sowed, so shall you reap.

born.name: John Thanos
born.cause: prior to execution by lethal injection
